name: web-compliance
description: Generates filled-in, ready-to-paste AI coding prompts for website legal compliance — cookie banners, privacy policies, accessibility widgets and more — composed against per-jurisdiction rule packs. Ships 5 packs: Israel (Amendment 13, IS 5568), EU/EEA (GDPR, ePrivacy, EAA / WCAG 2.1 AA), UK (UK GDPR, PECR), US federal (CAN-SPAM, COPPA, ADA) and California (CCPA/CPRA, Global Privacy Control).
